cards.stem: What was a chief point of debate concerning national authority?
options: how much power to allow the central government
whether to abolish state courts entirely
how to fund a permanent navy
when to hold national elections
cards.quote: Among the chief points at issue were how much power to allow the central government, how many representatives in Congress to allow each state
cards.hint: Focus on powers discussed for the central authority.

cards.stem: How did delegates debate choosing members of Congress?
options: directly by the people or by the state legislators
by appointment of the chief executive
by lottery among property owners
cards.quote: how these representatives should be elected—directly by the people or by the state legislators.
cards.hint: Recall the election methods mentioned for representatives.

cards.stem: What was the stated original reason for gathering in Philadelphia?
options: to revise the Articles of Confederation
to declare independence from Britain
to negotiate a peace treaty with France
cards.quote: The Federal Convention convened in the State House (Independence Hall) in Philadelphia on May 14, 1787, to revise the Articles of Confederation.
cards.hint: Remember the initial purpose stated for convening.
